entry.title: contract/qcore/ctraces/ is a new family whose convention is one card's choice
entry.why: The family has one module. Its manifest placement (after `cmetrics/`, before `monkey/`) and the module name `context_lifetime.qcore`, paired with cmetrics' identically-named sibling, are W36-CORPUS-CONTRACTS-3's choice alone and no convention was found to follow. DISCHARGE: integrator confirmation, or a second `ctraces` module settling the convention.

reason: Confirm qcore-provider-ctraces ownership, the ctraces namespace and contracts/ctraces directory, and context_lifetime.qcore as the existing context/ID/span facade module. This confirms repository organization only; it proves no C body and does not prevent future modules for other families.
